description: Who may read and edit a wiki page, and where each right comes from: the page's own read and edit lists ('read', 'update' — empty means anybody the project shows the page to), the lists inherited from pages above ('readAbove', 'updateAbove', top first — a reader must be named by every one), whether the page still inherits them ('inherits': false once inheritance was broken there, and its own lists alone decide), the project's roles and groups of people ('sources.project'), and the grants that reach it — its own, or one «with all child pages» on a page above ('sources.grants', 'from' naming that page). People only to somebody of the project; anybody else gets counts.
name: get_wiki_page_access
title: Get wiki page access
